document.title: Broker's consolidated annual tax reporting statement
document.notes: A substitute statement, not a form. Form 8949 says of it: 'A substitute statement will have the same information as Form 1099-B or Form 1099-DA.' It routes nothing of its own — its constituents do. Its per-category summary table ('Summary of Proceeds, Gains & Losses, Adjustments and Withholding') is the usual real-world source of the Form 8949 category totals.

extraction.note: Read by the declared custom model, over the statement's SUMMARY pages only. The constituents' own prebuilt models cannot read this page: it prints four forms' totals and a Form 8949 category table at once, and it is where Schedule D's figures are. The per-lot detail pages are classified supporting-detail and are never read (spec 068 FR-028).

custom.reads: the summary pages of a broker's consolidated annual statement

summary_table.caption: Summary of proceeds, gains & losses, adjustments and withholding
summary_table.note: One row per Form 8949 category. Each row is its own reporting unit because the routes turn on facts that differ per category (a wash sale sends category A to Form 8949; a clean category D takes the Schedule D line 8a shortcut). net_gain names no box: it is the figure each row's own arithmetic is proved against, never a placed figure.

custom.not_declared: 1099-DA is in container_of but no measured statement has printed it; it is left undeclared rather than guessed. Fees and reconciliations print on these pages and belong to no constituent box — transcribed, routed nowhere (FR-004a). State tax withheld IS read, into each constituent's own state box (spec 080 T046), because each now reaches Schedule A 5a.
